metadata.audit_title: Forensic Audit of Corpus Length-Filtering Bias (>=4,000 Characters)

sub500_classification_audit.classification_method: Classification conducted on CAP metadata attributes (case name, name_abbreviation, docket_number, citation structure, and page order). Titles containing explicit certiorari or motion terms are classified as cert denials or motions; entries bearing formal docket numbers and sub-page placement in memorandum reporter sections without substantive opinion text are classified as procedural docket entries. Because CAP volume metadata caches omit full casebody opinion text for sub-500 records, the specific disposition (e.g. certiorari denial vs. appeal dismissal vs. summary order) cannot be differentiated for 97,977 records without full-text casebody retrieval. NOTE: The procedural docket records category and the unresolved specific disposition category are overlapping classifications, NOT mutually exclusive partitions: the 97,977 docket entries classified as procedural are simultaneously counted as unresolved because their specific legal disposition cannot be confirmed from metadata alone. Consequently, under the pre-registered guardrail, the sub-500 pool must not be asserted to be predominantly certiorari denials without qualification.
sub500_classification_audit.guardrail_status: RESTRICTED: Because unresolved_disposition_count (97,977) exceeds resolved classifications due to omission of casebody text in metadata caches, the sub-500 pool must NOT be asserted to be predominantly cert denials in manuscript text without explicit disclosure. NOTE: docket_count and unresolved_disposition_count are overlapping (not mutually exclusive) categories — docket records ARE the unresolved population.

haines_v_kerner.subject_domain: Civil Procedure / Pro Se Pleading Standard
haines_v_kerner.core_holding: Allegations of pro se prisoner complaint held to less stringent standards than formal pleadings drafted by lawyers.

united_states_v_diebold.core_holding: On motion for summary judgment, inferences drawn from underlying facts must be viewed in light most favorable to non-moving party.

dusky_v_united_states.subject_domain: Due Process / Competency to Stand Trial
dusky_v_united_states.core_holding: Constitutional test for competency requires present ability to consult with lawyer with reasonable degree of rational understanding.

lucas_v_earl.core_holding: Taxation cannot be escaped by anticipatory arrangements; fruit cannot be attributed to a different tree.

cooper_v_pate.core_holding: State prison inmates possess cause of action under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 for religious discrimination.

sipuel_v_board_of_regents.canonical_title: Sipuel v. Board of Regents of Univ. of Okla.
sipuel_v_board_of_regents.core_holding: State must provide legal education for Black applicants in conformity with Equal Protection as soon as for other applicants.

bolling_v_sharpe.core_holding: Racial segregation in District of Columbia public schools violates Due Process Clause of Fifth Amendment.

complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Denied federal citizenship to persons of African descent and invalidated Missouri Compromise.
Narrowly construed Privileges or Immunities Clause to protect only national citizenship rights.
Held Enforcement Act of 1870 applied only to state actions, not private conspiracies.
State statute excluding Black citizens from juries violates Equal Protection Clause.
Appellate jurisdiction requires a complete and final adjudication below.
Administrative regulations cannot alter or expand the terms of an act of Congress.
Invalidated public accommodations provisions of Civil Rights Act of 1875 under state action doctrine.
Facially neutral law administered with an evil eye and unequal hand violates Equal Protection.
Upheld state-mandated racial segregation under 'separate but equal' doctrine.
Municipal residential racial zoning ordinances violate 14th Amendment Due Process.
Articulated 'clear and present danger' test for speech restrictions during wartime.
State statute barring Black citizens from primary elections violates 14th Amendment.

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: Lash's Products Co. v. United States
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Manufacturer's excise tax applies to total sales price even if tax is passed on to purchaser.
Taxation cannot be escaped by anticipatory arrangements; fruit cannot be attributed to a different tree.

complete_audit_ledger.subject_domain: First Amendment / Freedom of the Press
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Prior restraints on publication violate 14th Amendment incorporation of free press guarantee.

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: United States v. Kirby Lumber Co.
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Repurchase of corporation's own bonds at less than par value results in taxable gross income.
Bankruptcy trustee avoids mortgage in toto for the benefit of all creditors, not just creditors prior to recording.

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: Missouri ex rel. Gaines v. Canada
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: State providing in-state legal education to white students must provide substantial equality in-state for Black students.
Prevailing party may appeal to reform decree adjudging patent valid though dismissed for non-infringement.
Upheld Fair Labor Standards Act regulating conditions of goods shipped in interstate commerce.

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: NLRB v. Nevada Consolidated Copper Corp.
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Reviewing court may not substitute its choice between conflicting inferences for that of administrative board.
Purely local consumption of wheat affects interstate commerce in the aggregate and is regulable by Congress.

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: West Virginia State Board of Education v. Barnette
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Compulsory flag salutes in public schools violate Free Speech Clause of First Amendment.
White primary elections conducted by political parties constitute state action violating 15th Amendment.
Upheld military internment of Japanese Americans under wartime emergency powers.
State segregation statutes placing undue burdens on interstate bus passengers violate Commerce Clause.
Incorporated Establishment Clause against states; reimbursement of bus fares for parochial students upheld.
Mandamus and prohibition are drastic remedies reserved for exceptional cases of usurpation of judicial power.

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: Sipuel v. Board of Regents of Univ. of Okla.
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: State must provide legal education for Black applicants in conformity with Equal Protection as soon as for other applicants.
Judicial enforcement of racially restrictive covenants by state courts constitutes discriminatory state action.
Separate law school for Black students lacked tangible and intangible equality, ordering admission to Univ. of Texas.
Segregating admitted Black graduate student inside classrooms and library violates Equal Protection.
Separate educational facilities are inherently unequal, violating 14th Amendment Equal Protection Clause.
Racial segregation in District of Columbia public schools violates Due Process Clause of Fifth Amendment.

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: Brown v. Board of Education II
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Remanded desegregation implementation to district courts to proceed 'with all deliberate speed.'
Court of Appeals must provide counsel to indigent appellant challenging good-faith certificate.
Affirmed per curiam invalidation of municipal bus segregation laws in Montgomery, Alabama.
Standard for in forma pauperis appeal is non-frivolous issue; appointed counsel required to advocate.
Federal judiciary is supreme in exposition of Constitution; states bound by Supreme Court desegregation rulings.

complete_audit_ledger.subject_domain: Due Process / Competency to Stand Trial
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Constitutional test for competency requires present ability to consult with lawyer with reasonable degree of rational understanding.
Redrawing municipal boundaries to disenfranchise Black voters violates 15th Amendment.
Exclusionary rule applies to state criminal proceedings via 14th Amendment Due Process.
Legislative apportionment claims under Equal Protection Clause are justiciable and not political questions.
On motion for summary judgment, inferences drawn from underlying facts must be viewed in light most favorable to non-moving party.
complete_audit_ledger.source_reference: CRS Civil Procedure References; West Standard

complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Scope of authority in emergency stay applications.
Sixth Amendment guarantee of counsel is fundamental and incorporated against states for all felony prosecutions.
Preliminary arraignment at which guilty plea entered is critical stage requiring assistance of counsel.
State prison inmates possess cause of action under 42 U.S.C. § 1983 for religious discrimination.

complete_audit_ledger.subject_domain: Equal Protection / One Person One Vote
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: State legislative districts must be apportioned on population basis ('one person, one vote').

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: Heart of Atlanta Motel v. United States
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Commerce Clause empowers Congress to prohibit racial discrimination in public accommodations.
Bill of Rights creates penumbral zones of privacy invalidating state bans on contraceptives for married couples.
Custodial interrogation requires procedural safeguards (Miranda warnings) to protect privilege against self-incrimination.
Statutes prohibiting interracial marriages violate Equal Protection and Due Process Clauses.
Police officer may stop and frisk suspect on reasonable articulable suspicion of weapon without probable cause.
Students do not shed constitutional rights to freedom of speech at the schoolhouse gate.
Advocacy of force is protected unless directed to inciting and likely to produce imminent lawless action.
Supreme Court will dismiss appeal of convicted defendant who becomes a fugitive from justice.
Federal courts have broad equitable powers including remedial busing to dismantle de jure dual school systems.
Established three-prong test: secular purpose, primary effect must not advance religion, no excessive entanglement.

complete_audit_ledger.canonical_title: New York Times Co. v. United States
complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Government carried heavy burden to justify prior restraint on publishing classified Pentagon Papers; injunction denied.

complete_audit_ledger.core_holding: Constitutional right of privacy encompasses pregnant woman's choice to terminate pregnancy.
Conviction of greater crime (felony murder) bars subsequent prosecution for lesser-included offense (robbery).
